Behaviour PR: write "Spec for #N" in the spec stage, and change it to "Closes #N" when you add the code. Other PRs: "Closes #N". -->

## Testing
<!-- Commands you ran and their output (ruff, pytest; live eval if the prompt or knowledge rules changed). -->

<!-- Required (CI checks this section is filled in). How it was run (/code-review, fresh-context subagent against REVIEW.md), what it found, and what you did about each finding. "No findings" is fine if true. -->

## Risk
<!-- low (docs/plans) · medium (engine or mod code) · high (knowledge.py, prompt building, save/load, .github/) — and why. -->

<!-- Usually "revert the squash commit". Note any data/migration or mod-side steps. -->
